mapper.sql: achievement.achievement_id, achievement.management_no, achievement.target_user_id, owner.login_id AS teacher_name, achievement.evaluation_year, achievement.management_item_code, achievement.achievement_date, achievement.special_lecture_start_date, achievement.special_lecture_end_date, achievement.mock_exam_question_period, achievement.certification_status, CASE WHEN achievement.attachment_refs = '[]' THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS has_attachments, achievement.created_at, achievement.updated_at

choose.when: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings requester_mapping JOIN organization_user_mappings target_mapping ON target_mapping.organization_code = requester_mapping.organization_code WHERE requester_mapping.user_id = #{requesterUserId} AND requester_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' AND target_mapping.user_id = achievement.target_user_id AND target_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' )

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_organization_mappings permission_mapping JOIN organization_user_mappings target_mapping ON target_mapping.organization_code = permission_mapping.organization_code WHERE permission_mapping.user_id = #{requesterUserId} AND permission_mapping.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' AND permission_mapping.data_scope IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'COLLEGE', 'BUSINESS', 'ALL') AND target_mapping.user_id = achievement.target_user_id AND target_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employment_rate_improvement_achievements achievement JOIN users owner ON owner.user_id = achievement.target_user_id

SELECT achievement.attachment_refs FROM employment_rate_improvement_achievements achievement WHERE achievement.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement.deleted_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employment_rate_improvement_achievements achievement WHERE achievement.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement.deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employment_rate_improvement_achievements ( management_no, target_user_id, evaluation_year, management_item_code, achievement_date, special_lecture_start_date, special_lecture_end_date, mock_exam_question_period, certification_status, attachment_refs, deleted_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{managementNo}, #{targetUserId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{request.managementItemCode}, #{request.achievementDate}, #{request.specialLectureStartDate}, #{request.specialLectureEndDate}, #{request.mockExamQuestionPeriod}, 'DRAFT', #{attachmentRefs}, 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE employment_rate_improvement_achievements SET management_item_code = #{request.managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{request.achievementDate}, special_lecture_start_date = #{request.specialLectureStartDate}, special_lecture_end_date = #{request.specialLectureEndDate}, mock_exam_question_period = #{request.mockExamQuestionPeriod}, attachment_refs = #{attachmentRefs}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, reason_code, opinion, processed_by, processed_at ) VALUES ( #{history.achievementType}, #{history.achievementId}, #{history.previousStatus}, #{history.nextStatus}, #{history.actionType}, #{history.reasonCode}, #{history.opinion}, #{history.processedBy}, #{history.processedAt} )

INSERT INTO data_change_histories ( target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id ) VALUES ( #{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, 'achievement_data', #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId} )
